title: Would you say my experience with this movie is ruined or saved now?

commenti.body:
You’ll ruin it forever if you always focus on the idea that you ruined it. 

If you can let go of the idea that you had one chance to watch it perfectly, and that blowing that chance means it’s “ruined,” then you’ll be fine. 

The movie is the movie. The only thing you can change is your attitude. Let yourself appreciate it when you watch it again.
